How you gonna use One Mic as the idea of supporting #MeToo, when it’s author and artist beat his fucking wife? 

I mean, I grew up listening to Nas as a damn near idol on the mic, but he’s an abuser. https://t.co/QZnEPinlWd

2/x I am damn happy about what #MeToo has accomplished, especially where women suffering sexual harassment, abuse and violence at work is concerned (it’s been most successful there). NO ONE should have to endure that or be silenced about it. We still need to do more.

7/x It’s basically the exact same story, except that the victims are male. 

As a male survivor, it’s a seriously disheartening thing. 

I also know that the #MeToo movement is causing a quake in the power structure and status quo, and that puts anyone associated with it at risk.

9/x Asia gets accused and it’s “Is this the end of #MeToo?” This shit would be laughable if it didn’t have such fucked up implications. Jim Jordan is still sitting in Congress. 

I don’t know how I personally feel about the statement Asia just released.
